description: Legal Affairs Department - Banking (Special Provisions) Act, No. 17 of 2023 Order under Section (2) of Section 1, shall come into Operation with effect from 15/11/2023
categorisation: This gazette content announces the commencement date of the Banking (Special Provisions) Act, No. 17 of 2023. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with the implementation of a specific banking law/act. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe by name, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his title, and the primary focus is on the legal instrument (the Act) coming into operation, not on government personnel or structural changes.
